alternatives.label: Mathematical modelling, Earth systems & scientific data
alternatives.concept: Use calculus, linear algebra, numerical methods, probability, differential and linear-system models, programming, machine learning, imaging and remote sensing to study the Earth system, climate, water, hazards, resources and environmental change. This is the strongest related-fields response to the selected climate-physics direction; it is not Physics or Astronomy equivalence.
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum contains a sustained mathematical and computational spine and a substantive Earth-system, climate, remote-sensing and environmental-research strand. The label avoids claiming mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum, statistical, astronomical or physics-laboratory formation.
progression: The schedule contains 24 unique courses, four per semester, PPD in Year 1 and six 300-level courses. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is available in its assigned Fall 2026 cohort semester. Sustainability Essentials I precedes Sustainability Essentials II, Earth-system tools, Earth observation, biogeochemistry and Earth resources; Mathematical Methods precedes all dependent mathematics and neural-network study. Introductory Earth and sustainability work precedes the advanced environmental research and resource courses.

core: Calculus, linear algebra, probability, numerical methods and dynamical or linear-system modelling
Programming, scientific data analysis, machine learning, imaging and remote sensing for natural systems
adjacent: Earth-system, ocean, glacier, climate, water, hazard and resource processes
Empirical investigation, field and laboratory evidence and applied environmental research

candidates.label: Fundamental and theoretical physics of fields, matter and quantum systems
Astronomy, astrophysics and the physical universe

blocks: Both establish calculus, matrices and differential-equation tools for quantitative science; the external course is embedded in a cumulative physics sequence.
Both develop linear mathematical structures used in physical models; UCR provides a general linear-algebra course rather than physics-specific mathematical techniques.
Both advance mathematical problem solving for natural systems; UCR focuses on numerical equations, integration and differential equations.
Both develop analysis of empirical data; UCR covers general data preparation, visualisation and research rather than physics-specific data acquisition.
Earth systems, climate and environmental research
Both study coupled atmosphere, ocean and climate processes; UCR approaches them through Earth-system modelling, proxies and tracers rather than a physics course in dynamical fluid equations.
Both require an empirical natural-system research project; UCR undertakes an externally partnered sustainability project rather than an experimental physics laboratory project.
Physics, astronomy, advanced research and profiling
UCR has no cumulative classical and relativistic mechanics course.
Image processing and Earth observation do not reproduce astronomy and optics.

selection.assessment: One complete related-fields programme passes the evidence, course-content and schedule gates. It responds to the selected climate-physics direction through mathematical modelling, scientific data and substantive Earth-system, climate, remote-sensing and environmental-research study. It is not represented as Physics and Astronomy. A fundamental/theoretical direction cannot supply mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, statistical physics, quantum theory, field theory or matter/particle depth. An astronomy direction cannot supply celestial mechanics, stellar and galactic astrophysics, cosmology, astronomical observation or instrumentation. A separate experimental-physics direction cannot supply cumulative physics laboratories, measurement instrumentation or a physics research sequence. These directions were assessed separately rather than filled with adjacent mathematics or environmental courses.

notes.text: The UCR programme provides substantial mathematical modelling, scientific data, Earth-system, climate, remote-sensing and environmental-research study. It does not supply the target’s cumulative mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, quantum and statistical physics, astronomy, physics-laboratory and independent physics-research formation.
